title: Atomic widget node with an unregistered widgetType 'e-not-a-real-widget' → on save atomic unknowns THROW → UNKNOWN_WIDGET_TYPE (valid:false)
_comment: WP-Q01 INVALID fixture (one-per-failure-mode, Detailed-Req #4; 14-fixtures-harness.md §1 trees/v4/invalid; 12-error-taxonomy.md §3.1 UNKNOWN_WIDGET_TYPE). The widgetType 'e-not-a-real-widget' is NOT registered (probe schema/registered-types); for an atomic node the real save THROWS (has-atomic-base.php:97,113). Validator::dry_run returns EXACTLY {valid:false, errors:[UNKNOWN_WIDGET_TYPE]} (VERIFIED live on Elementor 4.1.1) — its R2 check returns early for an unregistered type, so the deeper atomic settings/styles/R4 checks are NOT run and no other code is emitted. prefilter.verdict:reject — the F06 loader SKIPS authoring-schema validation for reject fixtures (fixture-loader.ts:206-230), which is required here because the frozen element-node schema's AtomicWidgetNode widgetType is a CLOSED enum that cannot contain an unknown 'e-foo' type (so a defer-encoding would fail that schema check; an 'e-' type also cannot route to the loose ClassicNode branch which forbids the atomic sibling keys styles/editor_settings/interactions). To satisfy the §4 pre-filter SUBSET contract (reject⇒the TS pre-filter MUST reject), the node also carries an intentional orphan local style 'e-u9k0001-deadc0d' present in `styles` but NOT mirrored into settings.classes.value — so the structural pre-filter (which has NO live registered-type/R2 check) rejects via R4/LOCAL_STYLE_UNLINKED. Both sides therefore agree the tree is INVALID (meta-invariant reject⇒valid:false holds); the AUTHORITATIVE PHP error SET that expect.errors compares against is the single UNKNOWN_WIDGET_TYPE.
